The '''2027 SA20 season''' (also known as '''Betway SA20 2027''' for sponsorship reasons) will be the fifth season of the [[SA20]], a franchise [[Twenty20]] cricket league in South Africa.<ref>{{cite web |title=Betway SA20 confirms competition window for the next three years |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-confirms-competition-window-for-the-next-three-years |access-date=4 February 2025 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The competition, organised by [[Cricket South Africa]], featured six teams.<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The tournament is set to take place from 17 January to 21 February 2027, with the final to be held in [[Cape Town]].<ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 2027 starts January 17, final in Cape Town on February 21|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/sa20-2027-starts-january-17-final-in-cape-town-on-february-21-1547158 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=Cricinfo}}</ref> [[Sunrisers Eastern Cape]] entered the tournament as the defending champions.<ref>{{cite web
|title=Report: Sunrisers Eastern Cape win third Betway SA20 title
|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/report-sunrisers-eastern-cape-win-third-betway-sa20-title
|website=Betway SA20
|publisher=Cricket South Africa
|access-date=3 August 2026
}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |access-date=25 January 2026 |title=SA20 Final 2026: Sunrisers Eastern Cape pips Pretoria Capitals to seal third title in four years |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/sa20-final-sunrisers-eastern-cape-vs-pretoria-capitals-third-title-stubbs-skipper-brevis-hundred-report/article70550742.ece |website=Sportstar}}</ref>

==Background ==
On 23 July 2026, [[Cricket South Africa]] announced the fixtures for the fifth season of the tournament. The competition was scheduled to be held from 17 January to 21 February 2027, with defending champions [[Sunrisers Eastern Cape]] facing [[Pretoria Capitals]] in the opening match at [[St George's Park, Gqeberha|St George's Park]], [[Gqeberha]]. The final was scheduled to take place at [[Newlands Cricket Ground]] in [[Cape Town]].<ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 2027 to be held from January 17 to February 21|url=https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/139630/schedule-announcement-sa20-2027-to-be-held-from-january-17-to-february-21-cricbuzzcom |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=Cricbuzz}}</ref>

On 5 August 2026, six franchises announced their retained and pre-signed players before the player auction, which was held on 7 October 2026.<ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://m.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/139750/marsh-root-among-marquee-sa20-additions-du-plessis-released-by-jsk
|title=Marsh, Root among marquee SA20 additions; du Plessis released by JSK
|website=Cricbuzz
|access-date=5 August 2026
}}</ref> Four franchises entered the auction with a combined 19 playing positions available, including a wildcard slot for [[Joburg Super Kings]] that was exempt from the salary cap. [[Durban's Super Giants]] and [[Paarl Royals]] completed their full 19-player squads before the auction and therefore did not require any further signings.<ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/mitchell-marsh-joins-root-curran-salt-in-star-studded-season-5-squad-reveal
|title=Mitchell Marsh joins Root, Curran & Salt in star-studded Season 5 squad reveal
|website=Betway SA20
|access-date=5 August 2026
}}</ref> 

A total of 789 players registered for the auction, with 156 shortlisted for the [[List of 2027 SA20 auctions and personnel signings|auction]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/faf-du-plessis-trent-boult-and-kieron-pollard-in-sa20-mini-auction-shortlist-1556754|title=Faf du Plessis, Trent Boult and Kieron Pollard in SA20 mini-auction shortlist|access-date=1 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/big-names-on-show-at-betway-sa20-season-5-player-auction|title=Big names on show at Betway SA20 Season 5 Player Auction|access-date=1 October 2026|work=SA20}}</ref> with the shortlist comprises 95 South African players and 61 overseas players.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://m.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/140353/du-plessis-van-der-dussen-among-156-players-shortlisted-for-sa20-auction|title=Du Plessis, van der Dussen among 156 players shortlisted for SA20 auction|access-date=1 October 2026|work=Cricbuzz}}</ref>

In the auction, [[Joburg Super Kings]] made six signings, including [[Faf du Plessis]], [[Kieron Pollard]] and 18-year-old all-rounder [[Jason Rowles]] for R2.9 million. [[MI Cape Town]] also made six signings, including [[Wiaan Mulder]] for R2.6 million, [[Shimron Hetmyer]] and [[Trent Boult]], who returned to the franchise. [[Pretoria Capitals]] signed five players, including [[Rassie van der Dussen]] and [[Temba Bavuma]], while defending champions [[Sunrisers Eastern Cape]] completed their squad with [[Nandre Burger]] and [[Craig Overton]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/legends-and-young-guns-light-up-betway-sa20-season-5-player-auction|title=Legends and young guns light up Betway SA20 Season 5 Player Auction|access-date=7 October 2026|work=SA20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/sa20-auction-jsk-sign-kieron-pollard-jason-rowles-mict-pick-shimron-hetmyer-and-trent-boult-1557573|title=SA20 auction: JSK sign Pollard, Rowles; MICT pick Hetmyer and Boult|access-date=8 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref>

=== Personnel changes ===
==== Coaching changes ====
Following [[Stephen Fleming]]'s departure from the [[Joburg Super Kings]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.joburgsuperkings.com/news-detail/514|title=Joburg Super Kings and Stephen Fleming to part ways|access-date=1 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref> [[Albie Morkel]] was named as the coach of the team in August.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.joburgsuperkings.com/news-detail/516|title=Joburg Super Kings Appoint Albie Morkel as Head Coach|work=Cricinfo|access-date=30 July 2026}}</ref>

==== Captaincy changes ====
[[Faf du Plessis]] was not retained for the 2027 season stepping down as the captain of the [[Joburg Super Kings]].
